rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim 9: a DR1 judgement on the same difference overrides the prototype default; DR1 row inc-103's notes (document-dr1-parity-backlog-p5-018) judge that once every identifier is required, as c-041 now settles, each empty identifier is mandatory and names itself in the error summary, and claim 10 makes that validation a constraint that overrides DR2.1's silent save.
outcome: DR1 judged this difference: if every identifier is required (c-041 settles that it is, and the identifier sets are already corrected so cattle are not asked for a tattoo), each identifier becomes mandatory and each empty box names itself in the error summary. That judgement and the ruling's validation override set aside DR2.1's silent save. When a trader presses 'Save and add another' or 'Save and finish' with any of the animal's identifiers blank, nothing is saved and each blank identifier shows its own error, linked to its field and worded 'Enter <a/an> <label in lower case>' ('Enter an ear tag', 'Enter a passport', 'Enter a microchip', 'Enter a tattoo', 'Enter a horse name'), replacing 'Enter at least one identifier for this animal'. The page's Save and continue and Save and return never block on missing identifiers, as in DR2.1: a partly entered animal stays incomplete. Germinal fields stay optional.
